summary: Hilton Grand Vacations Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a secondary offering by affiliates of Apollo Global Management (Selling Stockholders) of 5 million shares (plus up to 750k greenshoe), concurrently with a share repurchase of 750k shares from the underwriters under a board-approved plan. No price, premium, or expected close beyond June 4, 2026, is given. The company receives no proceeds. This structured secondary-plus-repurchase reduces overhang from Apollo's stake while returning capital to shareholders. Watch for pricing relative to HGV's last trade and any subsequent insider selling patterns.
